About Us

The Fragrance
of Trust

Laxmi Products, led by Director Jagpal Gajera, is a proudly Indian company dedicated to strengthening India's loban market. Partnered with Brisha Formulations, Nagpur, we supply premium natural white loban to retailers, wholesalers, and devotional stores across the country.

  • 🌿
    100% Natural Source — No synthetic binders, no harsh chemicals. Just pure, aromatic loban as nature intended.
  • 🏆
    Industry Recognition — Featured in Incense Media, the leading magazine for India's incense and fragrance trade.
  • 🚚
    Bulk Supply Ready — Consistent stock and reliable delivery for businesses of all sizes.
  • 🤝
    Trusted by Trade — Serving temples, retailers, and fragrance businesses across India.
